A '''wallscope''' was a surveillance package manufactured by [[PsiCor]] for [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] military intelligence. It operated using a photon spray, and had the ability to see through mirrored magnetic shields and even walls. Early models had issues with high dynamic ranges of light, where a sudden bright flash in the viewing area could destroy the retinas of the scope's operator.<ref name="Abyss" />
